acceptance: A non-interactive release-cut can finish in one invocation with a curated section supplied from a file, and the --check-curation gate still runs on that text.
No option skips or weakens the curation gate or the exact-origin/develop start check.
Tests cover the curated-input path and its refusal of raw generated text.
context:
Found during the v0.4.2 release (2026-10-04/05). Evidence: cut attempts at 670af9029, 48be0235a and ba304dc2e aborted with 'fetched origin/develop advanced from ... preserve the cut and its curated files'; the fourth attempt at 8ed0c64e1 succeeded only because develop stayed quiet. Related: dlv2-53-retire-legacy-release-path.

Progress 2026-10-06 (owner kept the legacy release path for 0.4.3): PR #2734, branch fix/release-cut-curated-section-input, worktree ../BenchBox.wt-cut-section, head d7c8b03ac. Mechanism chosen: CHANGELOG_SECTION=<path> on release-cut -> generate_changelog_entry.py --section-file writes the curated body as the [X.Y.Z] section (adds the header, replaces a section left by an earlier pass), and the editor step is skipped. The start check (release_cut_start.sh) and --check-curation still run; no option skips either. The alternative (resume against the recorded start commit) was not chosen because it would loosen the exact-origin/develop start check. Also fixed: new sections now go below [Unreleased] (the generator used to insert above it). Release guide documents the non-interactive flow. Evidence: generator and recipe tests (201 passed across generator, release infrastructure, tag guard, release flow); end-to-end against a local bare origin with gh stubbed: one invocation of make release-cut VERSION=9.9.9 CHANGELOG_SECTION=<curated> with no TTY and no EDITOR exited 0 and pushed v9.9.9 to the local origin with the section below [Unreleased]; with a raw commit subject in the file it stopped at the curation gate (exit 2) and pushed nothing. Blocker: oracle-review needs the owner's stand-in for d7c8b03ac (Makefile change; Codex out of quota). Resume: re-take, confirm mergedAt and required contexts, finish.
description: `make release-cut` opens $EDITOR for changelog curation only when stdin is a terminal. A non-interactive cut (an agent, or CI) therefore needs two passes: the first writes the raw generated section and stops at the curation gate, and the second resumes after someone curates the file. The resume refuses to continue when fetched origin/develop has moved past the cut's starting commit (scripts/release_cut_start.sh), so the cut must be aborted and restarted. During the v0.4.2 release, develop merged a PR every 5-20 minutes and the first pass took about 5 minutes; three of the first four agent attempts aborted this way. A pty-plus-EDITOR workaround was refused as a gate bypass, correctly. Add a supported way to supply curated text in the same pass, for example a CHANGELOG_SECTION=<path> input that the curation gate still checks, or make the resume compare against the recorded start commit rather than the live develop head when only curated files changed. Coordinate with dlv2-53, which may retire this path.
